context: This criteria evaluates the ability to extend HTTP client functionality using the plugin system, applying middleware functions to modify requests before sending.

checklist.name: Plugin application
checklist.description: Correctly applies plugins using the use method to extend request functionality

checklist.name: Plugin implementation
checklist.description: Creates properly structured plugin functions that accept a request object and modify it

checklist.name: Plugin chaining
checklist.description: Demonstrates ability to chain multiple plugins together and apply them in sequence
